verdict.rationale: A live probe found https://docs.unstructured.io/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with an explicit "Agent Instructions" section that points agents to key MCP server, SDK, and API links. Docs pages are also served as raw .md endpoints (e.g., the transform quickstart and connector pages), and the docs explicitly target Claude and coding-agent tooling. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of an agent actually consuming these docs end-to-end, and evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
